title: FATS: A Prompt Injection Attack Utilizing Feign Security Agents with Deceptive Few-shots Learning
abstract: arXiv:2410.08776v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) face significant security risks despite their advanced capabilities. While techniques like Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) improve ethical alignment, excessive exposure to security-related training data may cause LLMs to overtrust such information, creating new vulnerabilities. Investigating this issue, we propose a novel attack method termed FATS (Feign Agent Attack with Toxic-shots). By obfuscating preference extraction, compromising toxicity samples, and inducing malicious behavior, we can effectively mislead LLMs into generating harmful outputs. translated_title: FATS：一种利用伪装安全代理与欺骗性少样本学习的提示注入攻击
translated_abstract: 大语言模型尽管具备先进的能力，但仍然面临着重大的安全风险。虽然诸如基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等技术可以改善伦理对齐，但过度接触安全相关的训练数据可能导致LLM过度信任此类信息，从而产生新的漏洞。针对这一问题，我们提出了一种名为FATS（带毒性样本的伪装代理攻击）的新型攻击方法。通过混淆偏好提取、污染毒性样本以及诱导恶意行为，我们可以有效地误导LLM生成有害输出。为了评估FATS的有效性，我们引入了FAQuery数据集，并在多种LLM上进行了实验。实验选用了Advbench等知名基准来评估该方法。结果表明，包括GPT-4.1（61.6%）和Deepseek-R1（99.3%）在内的主流模型都极易受到攻击。这凸显了严格……的必要性
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为FATS的新型提示注入攻击方法，通过伪装安全代理与欺骗性少样本学习误导大语言模型生成有害内容，实验表明GPT-4.1和Deepseek-R1等主流模型的攻击成功率分别高达61.6%和99.3%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FATS, a novel prompt injection attack that exploits feigned security agents and deceptive few-shot learning to mislead LLMs into generating harmful outputs, achieving attack success rates of 61.6% on GPT-4.1 and 99.3% on Deepseek-R1.
